rows.corpus_definition: Something that is not important or has very little value.
rows.example_en: They spent hours arguing over a trivial matter.

rows.corpus_definition: Produced using a mechanical machine with keys.
rows.example_en: The old document was clearly typewritten.

rows.corpus_definition: A very large and powerful tropical storm with strong winds.
rows.example_en: The typhoon caused massive damage along the coast.

rows.corpus_definition: existing as a hidden or basic cause of something
rows.example_en: Stress may be the underlying cause of his illness.

rows.corpus_definition: The state of being joined together as one.
rows.example_en: Their team showed great unity during the game.

rows.corpus_definition: In a vertical or straight position.
rows.example_en: Please keep the box in an upright position.

rows.corpus_definition: To make practical use of something.
rows.example_en: We must utilize all available resources effectively.

rows.corpus_definition: To make a sound with your voice or say words.
rows.example_en: She did not utter a single word.

rows.corpus_definition: A job that is available for someone to take.
rows.example_en: There is a vacancy in the marketing department.

rows.corpus_definition: without success or producing no useful result
rows.example_en: The firefighters made a vain attempt to save the house.
